stub stream sockfd acceptance, kernel reference, shutdown/reset lifecycle

limitations: This is source review, not a successful kernel experiment or test execution. Root must compile and run unchanged frozen inputs.

The positive path preopens and verifies attributes, but does not runtime-test old attr after hotplug removal/rebind. Fixed kernel source supports non-retargeting; no experimental oldattr negative claim.
Both socket endpoints held by one guest kernel make explicitSHUT_RDWR essential; twohost production broker ownership/EOF handoff is future work.
Hardblocked sysfs kernel call cannot be killed safely by a Rust deadline; overall disposableVM timeout is evidence failure, not product cleanup proof.
NoTLS, certificateauthentication, plaintextbypass resistance, realhardware G1/G2, or complete Phase3 implementation established.
